encryption.description: The minimum encryption scope a machine of the type requires (design section 3.1). doctor --target names it; the checkout cannot show a machine's disks, so it is not checked there.

declares.description: What a machine of the type must declare in its host_vars, besides platform_family. tap: the network tap's mode, source, ports and management interface (design section 3.8).

checks.description: What doctor --target --live reads on each machine of the type and holds to its rule. automatic-updates: the machine installs security updates by itself (unattended-upgrades enabled, its apt timers on, APT::Periodic asking for both).

inputs.description: Values a machine of the type needs from the site's configuration before it is changed: each an Ansible variable, read where Ansible would for the machine (its host_vars, its inventory line, its group's group_vars, group_vars/all, the [group:vars] sections). One that is not set, or is one of `refuse`, is refused before any phase (GB-414); a templated value is taken as set.

services.description: Components of ops/pins/fleet-pins.yaml the machine runs (design section 3.9): join-node deploys each to it after the phases, and standup's phase 14 to the type's machines at the site, through deploy itself. Not for a type standup builds in obs-legs.

source.description: The repository the type's plays from: source are in, pinned by a full commit or by a tag and the SSH key that signs it (design section 3.10). A run fetches it with the person's own git access and holds the kept copy to it; the loader checks the URL holds no credential and that exactly one of commit and tag pins it.

play.description: A file of ops/ansible, or for a play from: source its path inside the source repository.

args.description: Words for ansible-playbook. No shell syntax. It must limit the play to a group: -e target={group}.

from.description: Where the play lives when it is not in this repository: overlay, source (the type's own source:), or owner/repository.

phase.description: Exactly one of plays, builtin, component and skip; a component has a skip beside it, the reason when no pin for it exists (checked by the loader).

component.description: A release component of the pins (artifact_type: release): installed at its pin, or skipped with the reason in skip.
